summary_en: This phase 2 study tests whether pembrolizumab given after ablative radiotherapy is safe in people with advanced adrenocortical carcinoma. All participants first receive ablative radiotherapy, and pembrolizumab may begin after that radiotherapy is finished; the length and schedule of pembrolizumab treatment are not stated. The study's main goal is to determine whether pembrolizumab after this radiotherapy is safe and causes few or mild side effects.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa si el pembrolizumab administrado después de radioterapia ablativa es seguro en personas con carcinoma adrenocortical avanzado. Todos los participantes reciben primero radioterapia ablativa, y el pembrolizumab puede iniciarse después de terminar la radioterapia; la duración y el calendario del tratamiento con pembrolizumab no se indican. El objetivo principal del estudio es determinar si el pembrolizumab después de esta radioterapia es seguro y causa pocos efectos secundarios o efectos leves.
who_for: Histologically or cytologically confirmed metastatic adrenocortical carcinoma with symptomatic liver metastases.
Measurable disease by RECIST v1.1, with radiologic evidence of extrahepatic metastases.
At least 15 years old on the day of informed consent.
ECOG performance status 0, or Karnofsky at least 50% (Lansky at least 50% if under 16).
Adequate blood, kidney, liver and clotting lab values within 28 days of treatment start.
not_for: Prior anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, anti-PD-L2, anti-CD137, or anti-CTLA-4 antibody therapy.
Active brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis.
Active autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment in the past 3 months, or systemic steroids or immunosuppressants within 7 days before study Day 1.
Interstitial lung disease, current pneumonitis, or past non-infectious pneumonitis that needed steroids.
Known HIV, or active hepatitis B or hepatitis C.
